newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Tuesday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Tuesday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Tuesday:

Spokesman Joao Vale de Almeida said the Commission had received a reaction from Spanish telecoms company Telefonica, following complaints to the Commission by Spanish opponents. He said the Commission was currently analysing the information.

Vale de Almeida said the Commission was taking "very seriously" allegations expressed in the Belgian De Morgen newspaper concerning a contract between the Commission and Group 4 Securitas. He said that during regular controls made since the beginning of the contract in 1992, the Commission had found no proof of any permanent situation of fraud or corruption implying Commission officials. Vale de Almeida said the Commission would continue to investigate the case.
The Commission released the following documents:
- Eusrostat news release No 59/97: EU industrial production up 1.1%.
- Eurostat - Statistics in focus - Agriculture, forestry and fisheries No 1997-13: Trends in the EU agricultural price indices in the first quarter of 1997.
